bluf: K2 now trades as Altavia Kamikaze + K2, a Polish creative, media and martech shop inside the Altavia group since Altavia Kamikaze took over K2 Precise and K2 Create, a deal dated only by a July 2023 news page. It sells precision media and brand campaigns to enterprise clients and claims 25 years, 217 awards and 984 clients, while its house is at rest: nothing updated in the sitemap for 12 months and no ads of its own found. The one thing a rival should know: all 5 clients on record are names only, and it is likely that accounts in a rebrand transition answer the phone.

Altavia Kamikaze + K2 positions itself as a creative, media and martech organisation within the international Altavia group, pairing precision media and ecommerce performance with integrated brand campaigns: in plain words, a media and analytics unit (K2 Precise) and a creative unit (K2 Create) sold together under the group's Polish brand. Its headline claim is longevity and volume, 25 years in the market, 217 awards and 984 clients, and its showcase is a global campaign for The Witcher game run across 11 markets.

The mix is twelve services: performance, ecommerce, multiscreen (TV plus digital video), programmatic, social, SEO/SEM, business intelligence, analytics, marketing automation, ATL communication, brand strategy and branding, with no line above 2. Three core lines score 2. Data & Measurement rests on a title touting AI and Big Data solutions, K2 Precise listing business intelligence and analytics, and a conversion analytics service URL. Programmatic & CTV rests on K2 Precise pairing TV planning with digital and listing Multiscreen and Programmatic. SEO rests on a homepage case for Leroy Merlin lifting ecommerce revenue 74% and SEO/SEM under K2 Precise. Paid Search and Paid Social score only 1 for a shop selling precision media. No proprietary product and no partner is listed.

Its AI posture is a title, not a service: no AI service is shown, the group title touts AI and Big Data, and one news item covers AI in a coding course campaign; AI Search / GEO scores 0.

The moves on record carry no dates: the takeover by Altavia Kamikaze, and K2 Precise tender wins for Volkswagen Group Polska (Volkswagen passenger cars, Seat and Cupra) and for Queisser Pharma's Doppelherz. No pricing signal is recorded. Absent: no office, founding year, employee count, jobs or case study describing the work, no llms.txt, and no move with a date, so the last thing the record can time is the 2023 news page.
clients:

openings:
The strongest opening is the transition. Brand status is acquired and rebranded, and the only dated trace is a news page from July 2023, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that accounts unsettled by the rebrand answer the phone, and Leroy Merlin, already on the books of labelium and fifty-five, is the one to call first.
